prompt: In many countries, services that were once run by the state, such as prisons, railways and rubbish collection, are now operated by private companies under government contracts. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
In recent years, many governments have gave the control of public services like prisons, railways and rubbish collection to private companies. Some people think this is a good idea, but others strongly disagree with it. In my opinion, this is a negative development for most of the services.

On the one hand, there are some positive points of private companies. They are usually more efficient than the government, because they want to make profit and they do not want to waste money. For example, a private company can collect the rubbish faster and with less workers, so the government can save money. Also, private companies can bring new technology and new ideas, which the government departments often do not have.

On the other hand, the main aim of private company is to make profit, not to help the people. For this reason, they may reduce the quality of service to save money. For instance, in private prisons the company may employ less guards and give the prisoners poor food, which can cause the violence. In the railways, the ticket prices can become very high, so the poor people cannot afford to travel to their work. Moreover, if the company go bankrupt, the service will stop and the government has to take it back, which cost a lot of money.

In conclusion, although private companies can be more efficient, I believe that important public services like prisons and railways should be run by the government, because profit should not be more important than people's welfare. However, simple services like rubbish collection can be given to private companies.
title: Private companies running public services
